candidates.name: Gojek Group
candidates.description: Gojek is the direct regional equivalent to Grab, offering a nearly identical multi-service superapp model including ride-hailing, food delivery, and payments in Southeast Asia.
candidates.rationale: Gojek directly overlaps Grab’s super-app model, serving the same consumers and merchants through ride-hailing, delivery, and payment services.

candidates.name: Careem
candidates.description: Careem operates as the leading superapp for the Middle East, mirroring the Grab ecosystem by integrating mobility, food delivery, and digital payments.
candidates.rationale: Careem is a directly comparable super-app offering ride-hailing, food delivery, and digital payments to overlapping consumer and merchant users.

candidates.name: Bolt Technology OÜ
candidates.description: Bolt is a major multi-service mobility platform that has expanded from ride-hailing into food and grocery delivery, mirroring Grab's core business diversification.
candidates.rationale: Both operate consumer super-app-style platforms centered on ride-hailing and delivery, serving overlapping riders, couriers, drivers, and merchants.

candidates.name: Uber Technologies
candidates.description: Uber provides the global benchmark for the core ride-sharing and food delivery services that serve as the foundation for Grab's superapp model.
candidates.rationale: Uber directly overlaps Grab in app-based ride-hailing and food delivery, serving the same consumers, drivers, couriers, and merchants.

candidates.name: wownow-kh
candidates.description: WOWNOW operates a digital life ecosystem that aggregates various lifestyle services, including delivery and transportation, similar to Grab's superapp architecture.
candidates.rationale: WOWNOW’s super-app combines delivery and transportation services, directly overlapping Grab’s core offerings and serving the same consumers and merchants.

candidates.name: Little Limited
candidates.description: Little is explicitly designed as an everyday superapp that addresses daily lifestyle needs through integrated ride-hailing and delivery services.
candidates.rationale: Little is a consumer super-app offering integrated ride-hailing and delivery, directly overlapping Grab’s core services and user jobs.

candidates.name: Yori
candidates.description: Yori is positioned as a comprehensive superapp that unifies transportation, delivery, and services into a single consumer-facing platform.
candidates.rationale: Yori’s consumer superapp combines transportation and delivery, directly overlapping Grab’s core services and serving the same users and merchant ecosystem.

candidates.name: We1
candidates.description: We1 functions as a regional superapp offering an integrated platform for rides, deliveries, and business services.
candidates.rationale: We1 overlaps Grab’s core super-app model, offering rides and deliveries through one platform to similar consumers, merchants, and service providers.

candidates.name: MyKuya
candidates.description: MyKuya connects users to on-demand services, deliveries, and personal assistance, reflecting the service-aggregation model of the Grab platform.
candidates.rationale: Both operate consumer on-demand service marketplaces, with overlapping delivery and local assistance use cases accessed through an app.

candidates.name: Nonstopcourier
candidates.description: Nonstop provides a one-stop app solution combining taxi services, delivery, and courier functions.
candidates.rationale: Nonstop offers an app combining on-demand taxi and delivery services, directly overlapping Grab’s core mobility and logistics marketplace use cases.

candidates.name: Xpress
candidates.description: Xpress Super App provides an all-in-one platform for urban mobility, delivery, and daily commute solutions.
candidates.rationale: Xpress is a super-app offering urban mobility and delivery, directly overlapping Grab’s ride-hailing and delivery use cases for consumers and merchants.

candidates.name: Zig
candidates.description: Zig by ComfortDelGro is a mobility and lifestyle platform that helps riders and brands connect, mirroring elements of Grab's mobility ecosystem.
candidates.rationale: Zig offers app-based ride booking and mobility services, directly overlapping Grab’s ride-hailing platform for the same riders.

candidates.name: Squch Technologies LLC
candidates.description: Squch operates as a super application designed to manage daily digital lifestyle services.
candidates.rationale: Squch is a consumer super-app for daily digital services, aligning with Grab’s integrated ride, delivery, payment, and lifestyle-services model.

candidates.name: Getkari
candidates.description: Kari is a multi-purpose app that facilitates ride-sharing, grocery shopping, and online payments.
candidates.rationale: Both offer multi-purpose consumer apps combining ride-sharing, shopping or delivery, and digital payments for overlapping users and use cases.

candidates.name: Swifpack
candidates.description: Swifpack provides a combined solution for ride-sharing, delivery, and vehicle rental services.
candidates.rationale: Swifpack overlaps Grab’s core on-demand ride-sharing and delivery services, serving consumers and merchants with similar mobility and logistics needs.

candidates.name: RyvePool
candidates.description: RyvePool functions as a mobility and courier platform that connects users with drivers and businesses for integrated transport and delivery.
candidates.rationale: RyvePool overlaps Grab’s core ride-hailing and delivery marketplace, connecting users and businesses with drivers for on-demand transport and courier services.

candidates.name: Shgardi
candidates.description: Shgardi follows the 'do anything' app model, facilitating local delivery and on-demand errand services.
candidates.rationale: Shgardi’s on-demand local delivery and errand marketplace overlaps Grab’s delivery super-app services and serves similar consumers and merchants.

candidates.name: Tootle
candidates.description: Tootle serves as a pioneer ride-sharing and delivery-integrated platform in its respective market.
candidates.rationale: Tootle’s ride-sharing and delivery platform directly overlaps Grab’s core on-demand mobility and delivery services for the same users.

candidates.name: Skootar Logistics Company Limited
candidates.description: Skootar provides a business-focused on-demand platform for messenger, delivery, and transport services.
candidates.rationale: Skootar’s on-demand delivery and transport platform overlaps Grab’s delivery services and serves businesses needing app-based logistics.

candidates.name: Swiggy
candidates.description: Swiggy has evolved from food delivery into a broader 'convenience' superapp model including grocery and local service offerings.
candidates.rationale: Both operate consumer convenience super-apps with core food-delivery marketplaces serving overlapping consumers, restaurants, and local merchants.

candidates.name: Foodpanda
candidates.description: Foodpanda is a major regional competitor in the delivery space that has expanded into quick-commerce and broader lifestyle service integrations.
candidates.rationale: Both operate consumer delivery marketplaces serving restaurants, merchants, and users, with overlapping food delivery and quick-commerce offerings.

candidates.name: DoorDash
candidates.description: DoorDash offers a massive logistics platform for food and retail that increasingly competes with superapp-style service delivery.
candidates.rationale: Both operate on-demand delivery marketplaces connecting consumers, merchants, and couriers, with overlapping logistics services and buyer personas.

candidates.name: Lyft Inc
candidates.description: Lyft is a primary competitor in the ride-sharing space, which is one of the foundational revenue pillars for Grab.
candidates.rationale: Lyft and Grab both operate on-demand ride-hailing marketplaces serving riders and drivers for the same transportation job.

candidates.name: EASI Global Limited
candidates.description: Easi provides an integrated food delivery and takeaway service platform serving local restaurant ecosystems.
candidates.rationale: EASI’s food-delivery marketplace overlaps GrabFood, serving the same consumers and restaurant merchants for ordering, takeaway, and delivery.

candidates.name: Uklon Ltd
candidates.description: Uklon is a comprehensive online vehicle ordering and mobility service that expands beyond simple taxi booking.
candidates.rationale: Uklon’s on-demand ride-hailing and mobility platform directly overlaps Grab’s core transportation marketplace and serves the same riders and drivers.
